data.title: Family — Starter · Lesson 4
data.subject: family
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Here we go, let’s meet the neighbors…

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
New friends… Nuevos amigos  
Let’s go… Vamos  
Family time… Tiempo familiar  
We’re all here together.

[Verse]
Walking up, we smile and say,  
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto  
The sun is shining, skies are gray,  
But we feel so warm… pero nos sentimos tan cálidos  
My young aunt… mi tía joven  
Just arrived today.  
The single uncle… el tío soltero  
Brings a dish to share.  
My older cousin… mi prima mayor  
Laughs and starts to play.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
New friends… Nuevos amigos  
Let’s go… Vamos  
Family time… Tiempo familiar  
We’re all here together.

[Verse]
The twin sister… la hermana gemela  
Dances in the rain.  
The funny grandfather… el abuelo divertido  
Tells a joke again.  
The loving grandmother… la abuela cariñosa  
Hugs us all so tight.  
My mischievous nephews… mis sobrinos traviesos  
Chase a kite in flight.  
The welcoming family… la familia acogedora  
Makes us feel at home.
